behavior: Encore remembers Guard versus remote Detonate; an original Guard release cannot turn its repeat into a detonation.
A pending Detonate repeat snapshots stored pressure and never consumes a subsequently placed bunker.
Guard retains cast damage/proc/area through release, Mirror/Gun Shield shots and bunker creation/expiry.
Compel remembers manual push through an intervening Reaction; direct well placement, Throw, Crush, Grave and Pinball damage retain cast scale.
Each Compel retains its own Aftershock payload; original 0.6D and Encore 0.3D can both resolve.
design_ruling: Half strength applies to direct Q-created damage. Encore retains existing shared proc power and area rules. Independent resource/pressure procs (Full Tank, Meltdown, catches/Thorns) and subsequent passive well behavior keep ordinary rules.
